preconditions.description: The input contains exactly 4^n integers, where 4^n is between 1 and 2,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer in the input list is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the maximum possible beauty of the matrix, where beauty is computed recursively as the sum of the maximum element in the matrix and the beauties of its four 2^(n-1) × 2^(n-1) submatrices.

postconditions.expression: max_beauty == max(a) if n == 0 else max_beauty == max(a) + sum(max_beauty_submatrix for submatrix in submatrices)
postconditions.description: For n=0, the beauty is the maximum element in the matrix. For n>0, the beauty is the maximum element in the matrix plus the sum of the beauties of the four 2^(n-1) × 2^(n-1) submatrices.
